No provider-free synthetic reducer that combines partial chunk outputs into final schema.
Source span preservation through reduction is partial.
Object/event/relation dedupe and conflict policy need explicit fixture coverage.

blocker_reason: Pipeline exists and can be preflighted provider-free, but metadata/budget/reducer fixture gaps should be closed before private real e2e.
